hook: Postgres in one file, no Docker needed

beats.say: minipg packages PostgreSQL as a single executable. A dot pgdb folder holds the data, config, credentials and Postgres version.
It embeds the official Postgres eighteen Alpine image and runs it through h9, a Zig library whose Plan 9 kernel answers the system calls, so no Linux kernel boots.
Tools like psql start in their own tiny machine in about 90 milliseconds, though Postgres runs about two times slower than native for one client.
